dedupe_keys.name: dr train light rail dynamic response and gps

description: The DR-Train team releases dynamic response, GPS position, environmental and maintenance data from two Pittsburgh light-rail vehicles. The public Zenodo deposit is CC BY 4.0 and lists a data ZIP, README, region figure and processing-code ZIP. The describing article reports 31 months of observations for one vehicle and 11 months for the other between 2013 and 2016. These series can calibrate rail-vehicle condition models or test predictive-maintenance methods for transit-service resilience. A caveat is that GPS lock is delayed around tunnels and route direction affects sample counts, so location and temporal coverage need careful filtering. The dataset concerns two vehicles in one system, not a representative fleet. The round-one candidate was rejected as off topic, but its own record explicitly documents operating light-rail data for reuse. I read Zenodo metadata and the article Data Records without downloading the archive, running MATLAB code or checking every sensor channel. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
